newsitem.title: USA: Chancellor sees losses through H1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Chancellor sees losses through H1 1997.

text.p: Chancellor Corp said on Friday it expects to continue to incur losses at least through the first half of fiscal 1997 due to its restructuring and transition efforts.

The company also said it received an unqualified audit opinion for the fiscal year ended December 31, 1996. Chancellor said the opinion was its first since December, 1993, that did not include an explanatory paragraph concerning its ability to continue as a going concern.
The company also reported it lost $6.8 million or $1.32 per share for the fiscal year ended December 31, 1996 versus a loss of $1.2 million or $0.22 per share in fiscal 1995.
Chancellor, a lease financing company, also said it received access to $5 million in credit for new lease origination and working capital.
It said the capital included a $2.5 million term loan, of which $1.5 million has been made immediately available, and a $2.5 million line of credit available through its new banking alliances.
